description:
SHAPES Lewisham is a new free community space for creatives to meet, work, learn and collaborate at the heart of Deptford’s Creative Enterprise Zone.

Visit this Open House Festival to learn more about the Creative Enterprise Zone and how you can get involved in the SHAPES Lewisham community.

events.name: Drop in: Open Day
events.notes: Drop into SHAPES Lewisham to tour the space, learn what's happening in the Creative Enterprise Zone and find out how you can get involved.

factsheet.heading: About SHAPES Lewisham
paragraphs: The new SHAPES Lewisham space is a free community space for creatives to meet, work, learn and collaborate at the heart of Deptford’s Creative Enterprise Zone.
A place where ideas can be shared, projects can grow, and local people can come together through culture, creativity and collaboration.

Whether you want to run an event, host a workshop, showcase your work, start a discussion or bring people together, SHAPES Lewisham would love to hear from you. This Open House Festival visitors can discover what SHAPES Lewisham has to offer and find out how you can make use of the space!
